en: There's only one day until the time limit...

Don't worry, I'm not panicking.
I'm an astronaut, after all!

Oh, you wanna learn how to have peace 
of mind, like me? Alright, I'll show you how!

<CLT=cltMIND>I spent some time learning how to have
some peace of mind from Kaito...

<CLT=cltMIND>But he told me stories that made me
question his definition of peace of mind...
<CLT=cltMIND>Kaito and I grew a little closer today.
